Questions to ask any buyer's agent

Screenshot this. We already asked them for you.

"How many buyers did you close in my price range last year?"

Under 5 means they're learning on you.

"What's your fee, and who pays it?"

Since Aug 2024 it's in writing and negotiable. Sellers or builders often cover it — a good agent asks for that in the offer.

"Can I end our agreement if it isn't working?"

Look for a short term and an easy exit. Our partner agents agree to it.

"What did your last 3 winning offers look like?"

Real strategy beats "we'll write a strong offer."
